new_jobs.description:
Take a central role

The Bank of Canada has a vision to be a leading central bank—dynamic, engaged and trusted—committed to a better Canada. No other employer in the country offers you the unique opportunity to work at the very center of Canada’s economy, in an organization with significant impact on the economic and financial well-being of all Canadians. You will be challenged, energized and motivated to excel in our environment.

Building on the principles that have always guided us – excellence, integrity and respect – we strive to be forward-looking and innovative, to welcome people with diverse perspectives and talents, and to earn trust by living up to our commitments and by clearly explaining the intent of our policies and actions.

With our defined-benefit pension plan, benefits, and high flexibility for work life balance - find out more about why we are annually ranked as one of Canada's top employers: Working Here - Bank of Canada

Find out more about the next steps in our Recruitment process .

In addition to the position being staffed, this competition may be used to fill similar opportunities (Regular or Term) that become available at the same job grade. If you’re interested in this type of role, we encourage you to apply.

What You Will Do

As Director of Crisis Management and Continuity of Operations (CMCO), you will lead a function that is central to the Bank’s Crisis Management Framework (CMF) and its ability to prepare for, respond to and recover from significant disruptions. You will strengthen the team’s crisis-management role, ensuring that the CMF is not simply a framework on paper but a practical, tested and trusted operating model for timely assessment, escalation, executive decision-making and coordinated response.

The risk landscape is changing quickly. You will position CMCO to address faster-moving cyber, technology, third-party, physical and operational disruptions. You will support a multi-year effort to help the Bank anticipate AI-enabled threats, maintain critical operations during technology disruption, and strengthen the way business, technology, cyber, risk and suppliers work together on resilience.

You will lead CMCO’s evolution from a primarily planning-based function to an active, business-focused and AI-enabled resilience capability. The emphasis will be on the processes and operations that matter most, the dependencies that support them, practical contingency measures, scenario-based testing, and clear evidence that the Bank can continue priority outcomes under severe but plausible conditions.

In addition, you will

Lead and strengthen the Crisis Management Framework. Own the ongoing development, operationalization and assurance of the CMF, including governance, roles, escalation pathways, activation criteria, decision support, communications, playbooks and links to departmental and specialist incident-response arrangements.
Build a stronger crisis-management capability. Develop the team’s ability to assess emerging incidents, convene the right expertise quickly, maintain situational awareness, support executives, coordinate the corporate response and drive disciplined follow-through.
Adapt to the current risk environment. Translate emerging AI and cyber risks into practical business-readiness actions: confirm which critical operations must continue, understand technology and third-party dependencies, prepare for degraded service or accelerated remediation, and ensure contingency and recovery approaches are realistic.
Focus effort where it matters most. Use criticality, disruption tolerance, risk, dependency exposure and evidence to prioritize the processes requiring deeper assessment and investment. Simplify requirements and reduce low-value process, documentation and reporting.
Direct scenario-based testing. Establish a coordinated exercise program using severe but plausible scenarios, including cyber disruption, technology outages, third-party failures, loss of facilities, people constraints and multiple concurrent incidents. Test decision rights, escalation, workarounds, communications, recovery sequencing and executive readiness.
Lead the business-partner model. Set direction for CMCO business partners who advise departments, challenge and validate preparedness, connect dependencies across the enterprise and convert findings into practical, owned and measurable improvements.
Advance end-to-end operational resilience. Connect business processes with people, data, technology, facilities, suppliers and hand-offs so the Bank can understand how critical outcomes are delivered and where concentrated vulnerabilities exist.
Make the function AI enabled. Use AI responsibly to improve the quality and speed of analysis, dependency mapping, plan review, scenario development, exercise design, incident information synthesis, action tracking and executive reporting, while maintaining appropriate human judgment, security and governance.
Turn insights into sustained improvement. Lead after-action reviews, identify cross-cutting lessons, assign and track corrective actions, escalate persistent gaps and provide governance bodies with concise reporting on readiness, risk, dependencies and decisions required.
Lead people, priorities and resources. Create a clear strategy and roadmap, build a high-performing multidisciplinary team, manage resources and performance, and foster a culture that is calm under pressure, curious, pragmatic, collaborative and accountable.

What You Need To Succeed

Demonstrated success leading or materially transforming an enterprise crisis management, business continuity, operational resilience, emergency management, incident management or comparable risk function.
Credibility and sound judgment in high-pressure, ambiguous situations, with the ability to bring structure, identify what matters, and support timely senior-level decisions.
Experience designing and operationalizing enterprise frameworks, governance, escalation models, playbooks, exercises and improvement programs across decentralized teams.
Strong people leadership and the ability to set direction, develop talent, create accountability and lead through change.
Executive-level communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to synthesize complex operational information into implications, options and recommendations.
A practical understanding of operational dependencies across business processes, technology, cyber security, facilities, data, suppliers and people.
Experience establishing risk-informed priorities, scenario-based testing, readiness measures and evidence-based reporting.
The ability to influence across organizational boundaries and build trusted partnerships with business departments, Information Technology Services, Cyber Security, Enterprise Risk, Corporate Security, Facilities, Human Resources, Legal/Privacy, Communications and external partners.
A forward-looking approach to AI: able to understand how AI changes the threat and operating environment and how it can be used responsibly to strengthen resilience and team effectiveness.

Nice to have

Experience in central banking, financial services, critical infrastructure, government or another complex regulated environment.
Knowledge of the incident command system, crisis governance, business impact analysis, continuity planning, operational resilience, cyber/technology incident management and exercise design.
A recognized professional certification or designation in business continuity, operational resilience, emergency management or crisis management, such as CBCP, MBCI, or equivalent.
Knowledge of recognized incident management frameworks, such as ICS.
Experience applying AI, automation, analytics or knowledge-management tools to operational processes and decision support.

Your Education And Experience

This position requires a bachelor's degree and 10 years of progressively responsible leadership experience in crisis management, business continuity, operational resilience, emergency management, incident management, technology or cyber resilience, risk management, program delivery or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

In addition, you have led complex enterprise change, coordinated cross-functional stakeholders, advised senior leaders and translated strategy and frameworks into tested, sustainable operational capability.

Innovative Mindset

We value candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and a willingness to learn new technologies, including AI and digital tools. We seek individuals who can think critically about data, question existing processes, and find ways to simplify our work while embracing change and new ways of doing things.

Language requirement

The Bank’s work environment is conducive to the use of both of Canada’s official languages - English and French. The position language requirement is Level 5 (Fully Functional). If a qualified candidate who meets the language requirement of the position is not found, a qualified candidate who does not meet the language requirement may be considered. Training may be provided to help reach the required level. Both bilingual and unilingual candidates are encouraged to apply.

What You Need To Know

Hybrid Work Model

SOTI is seeking a Director, Sales Best Practices to strengthen how our global sales organization sells, operates and scales. This leader will define and drive the sales standards, best practices, operating rhythms and performance programs that help our teams execute a consistent, high-quality enterprise sales motion.

Working closely with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, Product, Finance and People teams, you will translate go-to-market priorities into practical sales processes, playbooks, coaching frameworks, onboarding programs and performance insights. You will use data and field feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and build targeted solutions that improve seller productivity, pipeline quality, win rates, forecast discipline and time-to-productivity.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines strategic thinking, strong field credibility, analytical judgment and disciplined execution, and who can build scalable Sales Excellence practices that support SOTI's continued global growth.

A strategic, hands-on Sales Excellence / Best Practices leader who understands complex enterprise sales organizations and can turn strategy into repeatable field execution.
A strong business partner who can work with senior sales leaders, challenge constructively, build alignment and influence across a global matrixed organization.
A data-driven operator who can identify performance gaps, determine root causes and translate insights into practical actions that improve sales outcomes.
A leader with strong knowledge of enterprise sales methodologies, pipeline management, opportunity qualification, manager coaching, onboarding and seller productivity.
Someone who can define what good looks like, build scalable best practices and create the governance and reinforcement required to drive sustained adoption.
A collaborative people leader who can build, coach and develop a high-performing Sales Excellence / Sales Enablement team.

Define and lead the global Sales Excellence / Best Practices strategy, operating model and roadmap in partnership with senior Sales Leadership.
Establish and continuously improve sales standards, best practices and repeatable ways of working across regions, segments and sales motions.

Use CRM, conversation intelligence and performance data to identify sales gaps, top-performer behaviors and opportunities to improve win rate, conversion, sales cycle, forecast accuracy and quota attainment.

Own the global onboarding and ramp framework for core sales roles, including curriculum, certification, readiness milestones and manager checkpoints.
Partner with Product Marketing and Product teams to embed competitive positioning, messaging, sales plays and product readiness into everyday field execution.
Lead or support major sales-readiness programs including Sales Kickoff, QBR enablement, manager forums and ongoing reinforcement initiatives.
Partner with Revenue Operations on CRM workflows, dashboards, leading indicators, forecasting discipline and sales-process governance.
Translate sales performance data into clear executive insights, recommendations and action plans.
Lead complex cross-functional Sales Excellence initiatives from problem definition through implementation, adoption and measurement.

Lead, coach and develop a high-performing Sales Excellence / Enablement team with clear priorities, accountability and measurable outcomes.
